A new Economist/YouGov poll released Sept. 22 found Trump's approval rating fell five points in a single week, from 40% to 35%, wiping out five straight weeks of gains in the same poll. The drop leaves him just two points above the lowest rating he's ever recorded in the survey and comes as Republicans enter the final stretch before November's midterm elections. [...] The Economist/YouGov survey was conducted Sept. 18-21 among 1,402 registered voters and has a margin of error of plus or minus 3.4 percentage points.
